requirement.value: Butcher or Cook (Gourmet) mastery + Cooking and Waste Not

system.description: When you prepare a delicacy you may take a portion of leftovers — a special ingredient carrying all the tastes used in it, which spoils at the end of the scene. Using leftovers, choose one of its tastes; it counts as an ingredient of that taste only. No leftovers from a delicacy made with leftovers, and one portion at a time.
